name: Wish Well
source:
Distant future. Interstellar navigation is common and humankind together with alien races populated most of the known galaxies. Galactic Integrated Space Army was created to protect confederation. A young man transferred to its academy in order to join this elite military unit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遥远的未来。星际航行很常见，人类和外星种族居住在大多数已知的星系中。银河综合太空军的成立是为了保护联邦。一名年轻人为了加入这支精锐部队而转学到了学院。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
